description: Paired three-arm measurement of the post-v13 hand line on the Diamond Princess record leg: the same 20 seeds at the v13 admissible-band midpoint Theta = 2.37e11, declared replay, hand_reservoir_mode in {hygiene_cycle, wash_reuptake, spike_decay}. hygiene_cycle is the shipped default (PR #804) and carries empty overrides per the baseline-arm convention; wash_reuptake is the NORO-HAND-RESERVOIR-01 arm and spike_decay the pre-repair baseline, so the pairwise deltas decompose the whole hand line into its RESERVOIR-01 and PRACTICE-01 steps on the record leg. This is the campaign canary AND the attribution instrument for the v14 re-screen: it runs in full (60 cells) before covid_theta_screen_v14 stage 1 submits, and its spike_decay-vs-hygiene_cycle deltas are quoted beside every v14 stage-2 row at 2.37e11. Cells enumerate arm-major: hygiene_cycle 0-19, wash_reuptake 20-39, spike_decay 40-59.
supersedes: nothing: it is the canary/attribution pair declared inside covid_theta_screen_v14.execution.canary, not a rescreening
prerequisites: NORO-HAND-RESERVOIR-01 (PRs #799/#802): hand-reservoir machinery; wash_reuptake arm; 42-cell census still_starved.
NORO-HAND-PRACTICE-01 (PR #804, this image): hygiene_cycle shipped default-ON; wash_reuptake and spike_decay labelled baselines, bit-identical on matched seeds.
covid_theta_screen_v13 (image edb7fc41): admissible set {1.78e11..5.62e11}, midpoint 2.37e11 carried here as the canary coordinate; the spike_decay arm approximates its hand physics on this image.

cell_conditioning.note: Declared replay, verbatim from the v10/v11/v13 stage-2 convention: diamond_princess_2020 scenario, onset_day -1.0 and departure_day 5.0 come from the scenario's own index record (the voyage_mode declared path), dwell_weighted sanitary visits, imports 1, infection_age_days 6.8 (declared value; measured-null under a declared onset_day, SEED-ONSET-01 -- carried only for cell-key bookkeeping), 20 matched seeds at base 20200205, full 32-day voyage (768 epochs, ~30 min/cell).
cell_conditioning.theta: 2.37e11 -- v13 admissible-band midpoint; fixed, no re-screen

arms.note: Shipped default since PR #804 -- the practice cycle (compliance-gated post-visit washes, routine washes, self-contact re-loading, wet-window deposit blend). Empty overrides per the baseline-arm convention.
NORO-HAND-RESERVOIR-01 arm: deterministic post-event wash + all-occupant pickup. wash_reuptake-vs-hygiene_cycle isolates PRACTICE-01's marginal effect on the record leg.
Pre-repair baseline: propensity-thinned spike-and-decay, the hand behaviour the v13 surfaces were measured under. spike_decay-vs-hygiene_cycle prices the whole post-v13 hand line on the record leg.

cells_note: 1 Theta x 3 arms x 20 seeds = 60 declared-replay cells (~30 min each). Arm-major enumeration: indices 0-19 hygiene_cycle, 20-39 wash_reuptake, 40-59 spike_decay, each over seeds 20200205-20200224 -- the same matched-seed block every stage-2 surface uses.

freeze.attribution_criterion: Declared before runs (stochastic-attribution skill): an arm effect counts only if the paired-seed delta on recorded_onsets or before_share exceeds the same-seed spread inside the baseline arm; takeoff class flips are counted per seed and reported as the fraction of 20 pairs. The clause itself is NOT rescored here -- the clause lives on the parent's stage-2 rows; this design reads the mechanism's marginal effect.
metrics: takeoff-seed count and q05-q95 recorded_onsets interval per arm (vs the clause's 197-containment test)
median before_share per arm vs the 0.173 anchor
route split by_infecting_epoch_dose (does the hand line's deposit blend move the direct_contact/fomite share measurably)
during-quarantine infection share per arm (does the practice cycle's dry-epoch deposit floor shift post-confinement transmission)

admissibility.note: No selection criterion -- this design is a mechanism assay and canary, not a screen. Nothing here may be quoted as a Theta fit; admissibility lives on the parent's frozen selector.
admissibility.index_geometry: Audit invariant verbatim from the parent: index_onset_day == -1.0 and index_shedding_at_day0 true on 100% of seeds; a deviation invalidates the cell.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_hand_ab_v1 --ARRAY_SIZE 60 --STRIDE 1 (the whole design is the canary). Job definition revision and image digest pinned per campaign-preflight step 3.
execution.report_immediately_if: the hygiene_cycle arm reads materially SUPPRESSIVE vs spike_decay on the record leg (the practice cycle's dry-epoch deposit floor cutting fomite/direct_contact acquisition enough to move the takeoff-seed median by more than the baseline's paired-seed spread) -- that is the mechanism the replay residual has been missing and it reroutes the stage-2 read; any arm is degenerate (zero hand-mediated pickup mass where the ledger requires it); the index-geometry invariant fails; or the child failure rate exceeds 5%.
